title: Iphone 12
description: The iPhone 12, launched in October 2020, features a 6.1-inch Super Retina XDR display and a sleek flat-edge design. Powered by the A14 Bionic chip, it delivers fast performance and supports 5G for faster connectivity. The dual 12MP cameras capture stunning photos and videos, even in low light. With MagSafe for easy accessories and wireless charging, the iPhone 12 blends power, style, and innovation.

title: IPhone 13
description: The iPhone 13, released in September 2021, features a 6.1-inch Super Retina XDR display with improved brightness and clarity. Powered by the A15 Bionic chip, it delivers faster performance and better efficiency. The dual 12MP cameras offer enhanced low-light photography and Cinematic mode for video. With 5G support, a longer battery life, and MagSafe compatibility, the iPhone 13 is a powerful and stylish upgrade.

title: IPhone 14
description: The iPhone 14, released in September 2022, features a 6.1-inch Super Retina XDR display and is powered by the A15 Bionic chip for fast performance. It boasts an improved dual 12MP camera system with better low-light photography and Action mode for smoother videos. With Crash Detection, 5G support, and longer battery life, the iPhone 14 is a reliable and powerful choice.

title: Iphone 15
description: The iPhone 15, released in September 2023, features a 6.1-inch Super Retina XDR display and a lightweight titanium design. Powered by the A16 Bionic chip, it delivers fast performance and efficiency. The upgraded 48MP main camera captures stunning detail, while Dynamic Island enhances user interactions. With USB-C charging, improved battery life, and 5G support, the iPhone 15 is a sleek and powerful upgrade.

title: iPad (Gen 6) - 2018
description: The iPad 6th generation, released in March 2018, features a 9.7-inch Retina display with True Tone for vibrant visuals. Powered by the A10 Fusion chip, it delivers smooth performance for everyday tasks, gaming, and multitasking. This model was the first budget iPad to support the Apple Pencil (1st Gen), making it great for note-taking and drawing. With an 8MP rear camera, Touch ID, and iOS support for multitasking features, the iPad 6 remains a solid choice for students and casual users.

title: iPad (Gen 7) - 2019
description: The iPad 7th generation, released in September 2019, features a 10.2-inch Retina display, making it larger than its predecessor for a better viewing experience. Powered by the A10 Fusion chip, it delivers smooth performance for browsing, streaming, and light multitasking. This model supports the Apple Pencil (1st Gen) and Smart Keyboard, enhancing productivity for students and professionals. With Touch ID, iPadOS support for multitasking, and an 8MP rear camera, the iPad 7 is a reliable and affordable choice for everyday use.
